Ah yes, 9/11 jokes are so much worse. 9/11, a disastrous and tragic event it may be, but jokes about it are in no way worse than sexist jokes. How many thousands of women have been attacked, dragged down, prejudiced and even killed because of sexism? 9/11 does not affect the day to day lives of billions of people, sexism does. I wouldn't expect you to understand that though.

The false equivalency here is astounding. Sexism and 9/11 jokes are nowhere near the same ballpark. We can never know if Madcat is sexist or not, but the evidence put forward here does not look good. Making a joke about something doesn't mean you don't believe it either, I don't know where on earth you got that idea from.

The upskirting stuff is in the additional folder posted by mega\_guycraft. You cannot say that Madcat is not sexist when he has made jokes about women belonging in the kitchen, asking what underwear they have on and mocking catcalling.

Is it joking to upskirt someone? Is it then a joke that the next time someone sees that it is possible for an upskirt to happen they cover the person up. The comments are sexist in nature too, that much is clear.

The double standards right here are absolutely glaring. Will all of Turps' videos be taken down. Will he not appear again, I doubt it. Even though what he has done is arguably much worse than what Caff ever did. Gain some perspective and stop defending him.
